item.title: Fatal Double Shooting, LNG Terminal, Emancipation Day
item.ns0:title: Fatal Double Shooting, LNG Terminal, Emancipation Day
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, a double shooting on West Bay Street leaves one man dead and another fighting for his life as police search for answers in a daylight attack. We investigate the growing concerns from a former Works Minister over the massive price tag of a new energy terminal and explore the potential economic fallout from a steep new US export tariff. Our team also brings you the sights and sounds of Emancipation Day celebrations in Fox Hill and a historic podium finish for Team Bahamas in international sports. Stay tuned for these stories and a look at the evolution of Caribbean music as our special coverage continues.
